title: **Dual-modal probe for detection of neurokinin-1 receptor and its application in lung cancer diagnosis**
protocol: Keep filled red-top blood-collection tubes upright for 30-60 min after drawing blood at room temperature to allow clot formation.
Centrifuge the blood sample using a horizontal rotor at 1100–1300 × g for 20 min at room temperature after clotting.
Refrigerate the tubes at 4 ºC if centrifugation is not immediate, but do not exceed 4 hours.
Use a pipette to transfer serum from each tube into a labeled cryovial.
If more than one tube per sample, combine and mix serum from all tubes in a 15 mL conical tube before aliquoting.
Close the caps of cryovials tightly after transferring serum.
Place all serum aliquots upright in a specimen box or rack at 4 °C.
Weigh out Rink amide resin into a plastic peptide-synthesis vessel and allow it to swell in DCM for 1 hour.
Wash the Rink amide resin by an intensive cycle of DMF (5×10 mL, 2 min each).

Attach amino acids \[Fmoc-Arg(Pbf)-OH; Fmoc-Lys(Boc)-OH; Fmoc-Lys(Alloc)-OH; Fmoc-Gln(Trt)-OH; Fmoc-Glu(OtBu)-OH; Fmoc-Phe-OH; Fmoc-Met-OH; Fmoc-Leu-OH; Fmoc-Gly-OH; Fmoc-Pro-OH] under microwave radiation conditions (35 W, 60 ± 5 °C, 20 min) according to a standard protocol.
Deprotect the attached amino acids.
Remove Fmoc protection group by agitating with 8.0 mL of 20% piperidine/DMF (vol/vol) under microwave radiation conditions (35 W, 60 ± 5 °C, 30 s).
Remove solvent by vacuum filtration.
Repeat removal of Fmoc protection group by agitating with 8.0 mL of 20% piperidine/DMF (vol/vol) under microwave radiation conditions (35 W, 60 ± 5 °C, 5 min).
Remove solvent by vacuum filtration.
Add Pd(PPh3)4 (0.05 mmol, 0.2 equiv.), PhSiH3 (12 mmol, 48 equiv.) in DCM (10 mL) under argon for 30 min after coupling Fmoc-Lys(Alloc)-OH.

Couple Terpyridine (1.5 mmol, 6.0 equiv.), 2-(4-((2-carboxyethyl)(ethyl)amino)styryl)-1,1,3-trimethyl-1H-benzo[e]indolium (0.75 mmol, 3.0 equiv.), and 2-(4,7,10-tris(2-(tert-butoxy)-2-oxoethyl)-1,4,7,10-tetraazacyclodecan-1-yl)acetic acid (0.75 mmol, 3.0 equiv.) at room temperature.
Cleave product from Rink amide resin using a cleavage cocktail of TFA-Tis-H2O (95:2.5:2.5, 10 mL) for 3 h.
Remove TFA and precipitate peptide three times by cold diethyl ether.
Centrifuge at speed (1000 × g) for 8 min at room temperature to prepare the peptide.
Purify crude peptides by high-performance liquid chromatography on an RP18-column using water/CH3CN with 0.05% TFA as the elution buffer.
Dissolve solid in water (20 mL) acidified with hydrochloric acid (0.1 N, 5 mL).
Lyophilize the solution.
Repeat the dissolution and lyophilization steps three times.
Identify the product by MALDI-TOF.
Add an aqueous solution of GdCl3 dropwise to an aqueous solution of the ligand at pH 3.0.
Stir the mixture for 6 hours.
Adjust the pH to 6.5 using a 1M NaOH solution.
Obtain the final Gd(III)-peptide complex as a purple powder after lyophilization.
Identify the formation of the complex by MALDI-TOF.
Dissolve peptide 1 in TBS buffer (pH 7.4, 50 mM Tris, 50 mM NaCl) at a concentration of 1 mM.
Store the peptide 1 solution at 4 °C for stability up to one month.
Add an equivalent amount of filtered FeCl₂ solution to the peptide 1 solution.
Incubate the mixture at 4°C for at least 24 hours to allow formation and aggregation of the Fe-peptide 1 complex.
